Theo Park: hey everyone — thrilled to join Redwood Inference today! I'm Theo (he/him), joining as a backend infra engineer. Based in Vancouver (PST), I bike to work, tinker with astrophotography, play cello on the side, and make a mean kimchi pancake. Looking forward to pairing on runtime perf and meeting folks in person. Quick Qs: where's the bike locker sign-up, and is there a preferred mug storage spot? :wave:
Onboarding Bot: Welcome, Theo! 
- Your onboarding buddy: Priyanka Rao (she/her)
- IT checklist sent to your email
- Badge pickup: Security Desk, Floor 1
Priyanka Rao: :wave: welcome Theo! excited to be your buddy — I can show you the bike locker and the best route for hills :) Lunch tomorrow? I usually grab pho on Thursdays. Also ping me if you want a plant start — i've got succulents.
Sam K: welcome!! :tada: Coffee rec: Gravity Brew on 5th (opens 8am). Also kimchi pancake trade? i'll bring snacks if you bring pancakes :yum: 
Maya Chen: hi Theo! Rooftop meet happens most Fridays at 12:30 — come say hi. Also we do a plant swap next Wednesday in the kitchen if you want a desk buddy plant.
Kai Nakamura: Hey! Bike locker sign-up is in the handbook: https://handbook.redwood.com/facilities/bike-lockers — if you want I can add you to the access list.
Rohan Singh: If VPN or Git access acts up, tag me in #eng-oncall. Quick check: did you get the github invite?
Theo Park: thanks y'all — github invite showed up, going to accept. Priyanka: lunch sounds great, i'll bring pancake samples Friday? (won't promise perfect cello accompaniment). Kai: I'd love the access list, thanks.
Juno Park: Welcome welcome! People Ops will swing by with a welcome sticker and a little desk plant. If you have dietary prefs for the welcome lunch, DM me. :seedling:
